description: This Java class, KeycloakUserService, provides methods to interact with Keycloak for user management operations such as creating, updating, and reading users based on email or ID.

classes.name: KeycloakUserService
classes.description: Service component that handles user operations with Keycloak, including creating, updating, and fetching user data.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user in Keycloak using the provided UserRepresentation object and returns the HTTP response status.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user in Keycloak identified by the UserRepresentation's ID.

methods.name: readUserByEmail
methods.description: Searches for users in Keycloak matching the given email and returns a list of UserRepresentation objects.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user's details from Keycloak using their ID; throws EntityNotFoundException if not found.
